summary: Compute native bootstrap UTXO digests and independent balance aggregates in one database scan
details: Native verification feeds bounded temporary balance aggregation from the canonical UTXO scan, removing the second full UTXO traversal. The balance table and temporary aggregates are still scanned and compared independently.
Canonical ordering, digest encoding, commit identities and publication gates are unchanged. Verification scratch state is removed on success, cancellation and errors.
Status and monitoring report the combined scan as scanning UTXOs and rebuilding balances, with real-work counters and unknown totals preserved. Older four-stage progress records remain supported.
operator_actions: Upgrade the node kit and matching usdb-services image through the normal release procedure to use the merged scan and its progress display. Existing sealed databases do not need to be rebuilt.
